headline: Indian Markets Set for Samvat 2083 Muhurat Trading as Nifty 50 Holds Above 25,000 Level

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Gift Nifty signals a positive start for the special Diwali Muhurat trading session today
Indian stocks recently posted their best weekly performance in six years, bucking global tech declines
Markets are entering the new Hindu calendar year Samvat 2083 with strong momentum
Historical data from the last 10 years shows a trend of positive performance during Muhurat sessions
whatHappening: The NSE and BSE will conduct a special one-hour Muhurat trading session starting at 2:20 PM
Nifty 50 is trading above the 25,000 mark as it enters the new Samvat year
Analysts have identified key support and resistance levels for the Nifty 50 and Sensex indices
Market participants are looking at recommendations for stocks like ITC and ICICI Bank for today's session
summary: Indian markets are set for the special Samvat 2083 Muhurat trading session with Nifty 50 maintaining levels above 25,000. Gift Nifty indicates a positive opening following a week where domestic indices outperformed global peers significantly. Trading is scheduled to begin at 2:20 PM today, with analysts highlighting ITC and ICICI Bank as top picks for the festive session.
